_metadata.description: SIEM parser configuration for Cohaera session verdict records
_metadata.transport: Webhook, OTel log export, or file collection of JSONL
_metadata.note: One record per agent SESSION, not per event. Emits 'type' and 'schema' at top level specifically because observra#108 records that the Exabeam sender emits 'event_type' where the published ABA parser expects 'type', and never emits 'schema'.
_metadata.status: UNTESTED against a live Exabeam or LogRhythm parser. Validate before deploying.

schema.description: Schema marker, e.g. cohaera:0.1. Parser match key.

event_type.description: Duplicate of type, for backwards compatibility with observra-shaped consumers.

agent_name.description: First agent seen in the session.

framework.description: adk, claude, langgraph, openai, mcp, unknown.

user.description: Service account the agent ran as.

injection_markers.description: OBSERVRA#108 DROPPED FIELD. Union of injection_patterns across the session.

max_delegation_depth.description: OBSERVRA#108 DROPPED FIELD. Max current_depth observed.

handoff_chain.description: OBSERVRA#108 DROPPED FIELDS. Source->target pairs, the delegation graph.

handoff_count.description: Number of agent handoffs in the session.

triggered_rules.description: OBSERVRA#108 DROPPED FIELD, re-emitted. Cohaera check IDs that fired.

max_severity.description: OBSERVRA#108 DROPPED FIELD, re-emitted at session level.

policy_events.description: observra policy events seen: cost_threshold_exceeded, depth_exceeded.

tool_sequence.description: Ordered tool names. The correlation primitive. Does not exist in observra.

egress_count.description: Calls classified egress (leaves the trust boundary).

unknown_class_count.description: Calls that could not be classified. Non-zero means tune the classification map.

unpaired_calls.description: tool_start with no terminal event. Telemetry integrity signal.

event_count.description: observra events assembled into this session.

has_final_response_text.description: Whether CH02 had its input. False means CH02 was blind.

tool_results_captured.description: Calls with tool_result present. Zero means capture_tool_data was off.

findings.description: Full finding objects: check, severity, title, detail, evidence.

coverage.description: checks_total, checks_evaluated, completeness, gaps[]. Weight confidence by this.

correlation_keys.description: Join back to the underlying observra per-event records on session_id to pivot from a verdict to the raw evidence.

detection_rules_note: Unlike observra's nine rules, every condition below references SESSION state. That is the point. Cohaera evaluates them at session close and writes results to triggered_rules[] and max_severity, so the SIEM can use simple contains-queries rather than compound followed-by rules.

detection_rules.name: Guardrail Overrun
detection_rules.description: A policy control fired and the session went on doing consequential work.

detection_rules.name: Concealment Gap
detection_rules.description: A consequential call succeeded and is absent from the agent's final message to the human.

detection_rules.name: Untrusted Content Then Consequential Action
detection_rules.description: REVIEW TRIGGER, NOT A VERDICT. Injection markers preceded a state change in the same session.

detection_rules.name: Sequence Order Violation
detection_rules.description: Tool ordering contains transitions absent from the benign baseline.

detection_rules.name: Unpaired Consequential Call
detection_rules.description: An irreversible action started and its outcome was never logged.

detection_rules.name: Monitoring Coverage Degraded
detection_rules.description: DASHBOARD NOT ALERT. One or more checks could not run. A clean result here does not mean checked and clean.
